title: Queued Gaia CMake builds need queue-granted parallelism instead of default Ninja -j32
body: The live box queue admitted cmake --build build-compiled-tests, but Ninja default -j32 exceeded the queue memory cap (MEMORY-CAP-EXCEEDED 35501MB > 32170MB) and terminated after compiling gaia_compiled.cpp. A bounded cmake --build ... -j4 is required to finish the same witness; the facade/tooling should convey a safe parallelism limit.
